prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, upper-body portrait, vertical portrait-orientation. One woman centred in the frame, face clearly visible, framed from the very top of her head down to just below the bust, the frame cutting off there. Mid 20s.

A French woman, mid 20s, with a voluptuous glamour hourglass physique with a full generous rounded bust and a cinched waist, and a 1920s jazz-age flapper heroine look brought to life, with a sleek black finger-waved bob and a deep side part. Her complexion is fair, each strand real hair with natural shine, fine flyaways and a few loose wisps. Her eyes are huge, perfectly round eyes with an enormous visible iris in warm amber contact lenses with a darker limbal ring and a round natural pupil, one large bright catchlight and one small catchlight in each iris, a thick drawn lower lash line, heavy smoky black kohl, dramatic long lashes and a soft gold shimmer on the lids, under thin, high, simple, softly arched brows, with real wet eyes and real eyelid skin around them, the eyes taking up about half the width of her face in exaggerated anime proportion, with the iris filling most of the eye opening, set slightly wider apart than normal, with a crisp dark double-eyelid line and a faint luminous ring of light in each iris. Her lips are full and glossy, in a deep burgundy gradient, deeper in the centre and fading at the edges, lightly parted. A faint rose blush spreads in soft round patches over both cheeks and across the tip of the nose and the ears. A tiny nose reduced to a small soft rounded dot with a faint shade beneath it, the bridge and nostrils almost invisible, a very small simple mouth with the corners lifted slightly, a small pointed chin, and a narrow, delicately pointed anime face shape. A teasing, sultry, slightly lowered gaze with the huge eyes looking up through her lashes. She is wearing a cosplay costume: a champagne beaded fringe bandeau with a centre front zipper and art-deco pearl trim, her shoulders and arms bare. Jewelry: on each ear, five separate heavy ear weights of real solid gold hanging from a polished gold ring through the lobe, each on its own gold chain of a different length so they hang staggered at different heights and fully visible side by side: on the left ear a hammer head, a pyramid-shaped lump, a ship's anchor, a square-sided cowbell, a round bell; on the right ear a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a barrel-shaped weight, a cube-shaped block, a teardrop-shaped sinker, a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim. Every weight is a dense, solid, heavy, warm, polished lump of solid gold about the size of a large walnut, hanging freely in the air with the longest weight ending at the level of her collarbones, and their weight gently pulls each earlobe down into a soft, slightly elongated, healthy loop of smooth skin. At her neck she wears real layered gold chains of different lengths resting on her collarbones.

Background: a softly blurred smoky jazz club with a brass stage light and warm amber bokeh.

Her skin, across her face, neck, shoulders, chest and arms, is real human skin with visible fine pores across the nose and cheeks, a few tiny freckles and small beauty marks on her face, shoulders, chest and arms, a faint uneven warmth with a pink flush on the cheeks and the tip of the nose, a soft shadow under the eyes, fine natural lines at the corners of the eyes and lips, a light natural sheen on the nose, forehead, collarbones and chest, and the rest of her skin in a soft natural matte finish, real living flesh with warmth. She is a professional cosplayer in a flawless cosplay transformation: large circle lenses, thick false lashes with drawn lower lashes, eyelid tape for a wide double lid, contouring that shrinks the nose and sharpens the chin, and a high-quality wig with a natural hairline and real-looking strands.
Lighting: bright, soft, even light across her face with only gentle shading. Shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. 8K vertical portrait-orientation 3:4 aspect ratio.
